roadmap.goal: ADO #6453 'Jira: work against the original (untranslated) status and work item type names'. Backend only (C# .NET 10). Three slices, delivered 01 -> 02 -> 03. Slice 01: Load from board and every refresh use the original names of statuses and work item types (status category key, untranslatedName with name as the Data Center fallback, de-duplication ignoring case, one memoised read of each list per connector instance, one re-read on an unknown id, visible failures with the approved Activity copy; conditions C-1, C-2, C-4). Slice 02: a Jira-only reading-version marker in the fetch fingerprint so every Jira Team and Portfolio takes one full refresh after the upgrade (DD-11, MD-15, condition C-3); its own droppable commit; the two Jira pinned-digest tests move on purpose. Slice 03: the eight Distinct calls in SuggestionsController compare ignoring case. Done when all 61 [Ignore]d test methods are un-ignored (55 in slice 01 including the five live methods, 2 in slice 02, 4 in slice 03) and green: 56 in the default run, and the five live methods green in a run with both tokens set (the crafter of 01-09 runs JiraOriginalNamesLiveTest with JiraLighthouseIntegrationTestToken and JiraLighthouseRestrictedIntegrationTestToken from the local environment; without them the class self-skips), the pins stay green, `dotnet build` has zero warnings and the filtered `dotnet test` is green. Release notes, docs, and mutation runs (>= 80 %) belong to finalization and are NOT steps here.
roadmap.paradigm_note: The Hypothesis + state-delta unit mandate from nw-roadmap does not apply, deliberately: the backend is NUnit 4 + Moq without a property-testing library, and DISTILL authored every scenario example-based with [TestCase]/[TestCaseSource] tables for finite axes. RED is removing [Ignore] and watching the test fail on its assertion, as the feature-delta's red classification records; GREEN is production code. DELIVER writes no new tests except where a step says so (the exact post-marker digest in step 02-01). Contract shapes (feature-delta, Driven Ports): JiraOriginalNames pure-function (return-only, no I/O, no logger); IssueFactory.CreateIssueFromJson pure-function, unchanged contract; connector lookup read bounded-change (one memo entry on the connector instance, no database, no Jira write, counted per route by the fake handler); board load pure read (every request a GET). No nWave scenario tags in code.
exit_gates: End of every step: `dotnet build` in Lighthouse.Backend with zero warnings (TreatWarningsAsErrors); the touched test classes green; no [Ignore] left on the methods the step un-ignores.

End of every phase-01 step that touches the connector or the factory (01-02, 01-04 .. 01-09): the whole Jira test folder (Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/Services/Implementation/WorkTrackingConnectors/Jira) green, plus the three API/Integration fixtures that reach a Jira download (ParentFromIssueLinks, ParentPlacementAcceptanceTest, NamedDependencyLinkAcceptanceTest) green. DISTILL could not prove the fixtures survive the new list reads before the connector reads them; this is where it is proven.

End of phase 01: the filtered `dotnet test --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"` green (CLAUDE.md's environmental signatures are not regressions); JiraBoardQueryAssemblyTest green with a real issue-type list answer in AReadableBoardExcept and board issues that carry type ids; JiraRouteLiteralsTest and ModuleBoundariesArchUnitTest green; every request the board load makes is a GET. The live class JiraOriginalNamesLiveTest has no [Ignore] and self-skips without both tokens (run locally with both tokens before the push, the maintainer's call).

Conditions from the review gate, each pinned by a test in the slice that implements it: C-1 (a non-null id a list lacks is never answered with the payload name, through JiraOriginalNames and through IssueFactory: steps 01-01 and 01-02); C-2 (board status id missing after one re-read is left out with a warning naming the id: step 01-07); C-3 (the non-Jira byte-identical fingerprint pin covers every WorkTrackingSystems value except Jira, parametrised: step 02-01); C-4 (the list read happens once in GetIssuesByQuery before the deployment branch, both download methods receive the lookup, the board load's status read goes through the same memo: steps 01-04 and 01-09).

End of phase 02: FetchShapingPropertyGuardTest, the non-Jira digest pins, FetchFingerprintTest and every other fingerprint test green unchanged; only the two Jira pinned digests moved, with their rationale text updated to name the marker; the commit is separate so `git revert` drops it alone.
End of phase 03: SuggestionsControllerTest green; `Distinct()` with no comparer no longer appears in SuggestionsController.cs; no other change in the file.

Sonar/analyzer rules pre-applied (docs/ci-learnings.md): S6667, CA2254, S2139, CA1859, S107, S2325/S1144, S3776 for the board and lookup code; tests NUnit2045/2056, NUnit4002, NUnit2046, NUnit1028, CA1861.

Comments in new code: rare, plain-language why, never an internal reference (no MD-, DD-, AC-, C-, O-, US- or ADR- numbers). Log and verdict copy is exactly the approved wording the DISTILL tests pin. EF migrations, frontend, API shapes and updaters are UNCHANGED; no step lists them.
roadmap.sizing_convention: Step size is counted in [Ignore]d test methods un-ignored (a [TestCase] row adds a test case, not a method). Target about 1-3 hours and at most about 8 methods per step.
